rul1.text: The Legends novels provide extensive detail about Bane, while canon acknowledges the essentials without presenting the same full biography on screen.

rul2.text: The novels' detailed biography and founding narrative are Legends unless separately confirmed by canon sources.

rul3.text: The Rule of Two is a promise of one master and one apprentice.

rul4.text: The Rule of Two concerns Sith succession and does not mean every dark-side follower is a Sith Lord.

rul5.text: In Legends, Bane and Zannah spent ten years building an intelligence network using credits from Qordis's account.

rul6.text: Current canon retains the Sith master-apprentice arrangement and connects its origin to Darth Bane.

rul7.text: Sith infighting and greed contributed to the order’s defeat at Ruusan in 1032 BBY, where the Jedi nearly destroyed the weakened Sith.

rul8.text: Bane was the sole survivor of the Brotherhood's destruction and recognized Sith infighting had weakened the Sith.

rul9.text: In the Legends account, Zannah was Bane’s apprentice after a war between the Sith and Jedi Orders and was tasked with carrying the Rule of Two forward.

rul10.text: The Rule of Two treats struggle and possible murder of the master as part of succession.
